title: MCP Client plugin settings
description: Dashboard-side settings for the mcp-client plugin (distinct from schema/mcp-config.schema.json, which describes the pi-mcp-adapter config).

adapterLoadTimeoutMs.description: Deadline in milliseconds for a pi-mcp-adapter config load. The load runs in a worker thread; on expiry the worker is terminated and the request fails with an adapter-timeout error.
